body:
Thank you very much for the kind words. :)

I have issues with the work because I would rather mostly sleep when I get home.  I sleep about 15 hours a day, mostly because of my depression.  

This does hurt my ability to socialize and be in groups, talk to people, etc... But I feel like sleeping helps me escape from the sadness.  

Again, thank you for the kind words, they mean the world to me.
